_help: Stripe Payment Links for calasautomations.com. One key per product/price. All prices CAD.
Paste the full https://buy.stripe.com/... link from Stripe > Payment Links into the matching key.
Leave a key as "" and its Pay button stays hidden on the site. Keys in the site that are not here are treated as empty.
Do not put anything but a full https:// URL in a value. No spaces, no notes. Notes go in _help.
See SETUP-PAYMENTS.md at the repo root for the step-by-step.
onfile_build      C$2,500 one-time  - On File build fee (accounting + trades pages). Refunded if the two-week run doesn't return 6 staff hours/week.
onfile_monthly    C$500 / month     - On File monthly plan, flat all year.
leadme_build      C$2,500 one-time  - Lead Me setup fee. Back if not live with 40 verified warm companies in 14 days.
leadme_monthly    C$500 / month     - Lead Me monthly plan.

quoteme_monthly   C$99 / month      - Quote Me per shop. Quote Me ALSO bills in-app once STRIPE_PRICE_ID_MONTHLY is set on the sitequote worker; this link is only the fallback for shops that sign up from the website rather than inside the app.

textback_monthly  C$29 / month      - Cara missed-call text-back (trades add-on). PRICE IS A HYPOTHESIS to test against real recovered calls; the trades page also mentions $19 for the first three months - do that as a Stripe coupon on the link if you want it, not a second price.
greenmile         by request        - no Payment Link yet; leave empty. The Green Mile page shows an introductory $25/mo per truck, but sales are by request for now.
watchpost_watch   by request        - no Payment Link yet; leave empty. Watchpost is early access, first month free.
